scope_assessment.specific_albuquerque_connection: Project Scope The John Brown Juvenile Justice Center located at 5100 Second St. NW is undergoing design of a new courtroom. Bernalillo County in partnership with Studio Southwest Architects’ are designing the addition of a new 3276 SF courtroom to meet the needs of the Second Judicial District Court. The courtroom will be located in the existing footprint of the building located on the first floor just north of the existing courtrooms. The $1.2 million renovation is schedule to start in early 2020. scope_assessment.specific_albuquerque_connection: Project Scope Bernalillo County’s Youth Service Center located at 5100 Second St. NW will be undergoing renovations in early 2020 to improve the aging conditions of the facility. The facility was erected in the mid 70’s and has gone through several additions as well as major tenant improvements. The goals of the project are to decrease violence and self-harm and keep both residence and staff safe.
